format: OpenJDK tzdb.dat (TZDB group, version 1): serialized java.time.zone.ZoneRules per region, read by the lab IcuZoneRulesProvider

source.note: IANA tz database 2022a as vendored by AOSP android-13.0.0_r1; public domain

compiler.license: GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0 (JSR-310 BSD notices in the files)
compiler.note: Classes ZoneRules, ZoneOffsetTransition, ZoneOffsetTransitionRule and Ser are renamed to package build.tools.tzdb by sed, as make/CopyInterimTZDB.gmk does

scope: Real IANA rules (transitions and recurring last-rules). Android 13 itself derives its java.time rules from ICU4J/ICU tz data of the same IANA release lineage; zone display names are not part of this file.
